# Unscii Font Notice

The retained `lv_font_unscii_8.c` and `lv_font_unscii_16.c` files were generated from the non-full `unscii-8.ttf` variant. Their generated headers limit the source range to `U+0020-U+007F`.

The Unscii author states that Unscii variants other than `unscii-16-full` are in the Public Domain and may alternatively be treated as CC0. The retained files do not use `unscii-16-full` or its GNU Unifont-derived data.

Upstream sources:

- https://viznut.fi/unscii/
- https://github.com/viznut/unscii

CC0 1.0 legal text: [CC0-1.0.txt](CC0-1.0.txt)
